children.value: > Fact From Story: The Braves have made a splash. Atlanta has traded its No. 7-ranked prospect, RHP Cole Phillips, and RHP Jackson Kowar to the Mariners in exchange for OF Jarred Kelenic, LHP Marco Gonzales, 1B Evan White and cash.
> > Fact From Story: Kelenic, 24, is the headliner of the deal as a former No. 6 overall pick in the 2018 MLB Draft and top five-ranked prospect in 2021.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: A highly-rated prospect is a talented player.
> Commonsense Knowledge: Trading for a player means that the team now has that player.
